svg.title: For a real anchor, h2 l ≤16 + μ2 ≤17. These estimates display the mass powers; they must not be silently replaced by two mass-independent unweighted bounds. Here is an explicit form of the strip-inverse argument. Suppose a matrix K, in the two specified weighted frames, has norm at most A, its real lower singular bound is a > 0, and the changes to frozen analytic frames cost at most C on a ball of radius σ. Test the analytic matrix on two unit vectors and apply the scalar Cauchy estimate. This gives derivative bound k = CAC/(σ/2) on the half ball. On the strip η = min{σ/2, (a/2)/(1 + k)}
